description: This Java abstract class defines common configuration properties for file-based device registry implementations in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes settings for file persistence, cache duration, modification permissions, and startup behavior.

classes.name: AbstractFileBasedRegistryConfigProperties
classes.description: Abstract class providing configurable properties for file-based device registry implementations, including cache duration, file persistence, modification permissions, and startup options.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the default filename for registry persistence.

methods.name: setCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache age in seconds; throws IllegalArgumentException if negative.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the current cache max age in seconds.

methods.name: isSaveToFile
methods.description: Checks if registry content should be saved to file.

methods.name: setSaveToFile
methods.description: Enables or disables saving registry content to file.

methods.name: isModificationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if modifications to the registry are allowed.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename used for persistence.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename for registry persistence.

methods.name: isStartEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the registry should start empty, ignoring provided JSON files.

methods.name: setStartEmpty
methods.description: Sets whether the registry should ignore startup JSON files and start empty.
